meta.bank: SNDPAC.BIN tone bank 0: sound RAM 0x16CB0 = file offset 0x1245E (file+0x4852 = sound RAM for file>=0x67AE; file[0..0x6774]+map load 1:1 lower)
meta.select: driver channel-cmd 4 value = instrument number; composed parts use voice-column byte 1-59; accompaniment uses 60+ctrl0; sound effects 69+
meta.pitch: playbackRate = 2^((note - rootPitch + fineTune/256 + transpose)/12); composed note = pitchColumn + 54; accompaniment note = pattern byte (+ctrl3 transpose on accomp ch 0-3)
meta.layerSelect: a note-on strikes EVERY layer whose [noteLo..noteHi] contains the note (detune/chorus pairs are two layers with the same range)
meta.velocity: sequencer always sends velocity 127; TL(base) = level + volAdj-derived attenuation
